name: Darkman
storyline: Scientist Peyton Westlake is left horribly disfigured after a brutal attack by gangsters. Using experimental synthetic skin that dissolves in sunlight, he creates disguises to impersonate his enemies and exact revenge on those who destroyed his life.
summary: A side-scrolling platformer based on the 1990 Sam Raimi film. Players control Darkman through action levels, using disguises that dissolve in sunlight to impersonate gangsters and gain their abilities. Between levels, a photography minigame determines how much time is granted for the next stage.
